headlessSupport.description: After installing Edge Pack, convert Ubuntu Desktop to a console-only system. Review each check before continuing.

steps.title: Use the console boot target
steps.description: Configure the system to boot without the graphical desktop.

steps.title: Stop the display manager
steps.description: Run from a text console or SSH session. This immediately ends active graphical sessions.

steps.title: Identify the GPU physical function
steps.description: Note the PCI address reported for the GPU.

steps.title: List the GPU device nodes
steps.description: Replace the example GPU_PF value with the PCI address from the previous command.

steps.title: Check for GPU clients
steps.description: Do not continue if this lists any processes. Stop them and run the check again.

steps.title: Install the Ubuntu Server package set
steps.description: Preserve packages shared with an Ubuntu Server installation before removing the desktop.
steps.command:
sudo apt update
sudo apt install ubuntu-server

steps.title: Preview the desktop purge
steps.description: Review the proposed package removals before continuing.
steps.command: sudo apt-get --simulate purge ubuntu-desktop ubuntu-desktop-minimal gdm3

steps.title: Remove desktop packages
steps.description: Run only after confirming the purge preview is safe for this deployment.
steps.command: sudo apt purge ubuntu-desktop ubuntu-desktop-minimal gdm3

steps.title: Preview unused dependency removal
steps.description: Review every package, especially on remote systems. Do not continue if required software is listed.

steps.title: Remove unused dependencies
steps.description: Run only after confirming the autoremove preview is safe.

steps.title: Reboot
steps.description: The system will restart into a text console.

verification.title: Verify after reboot
verification.description: Log in at the console and confirm the graphical environment is inactive.
verification.command:
# Should print: multi-user.target
systemctl get-default

# Should print inactive and disabled, or report that gdm3 is not installed
systemctl is-active gdm3
systemctl is-enabled gdm3

# Confirm no graphical target is active
systemctl status graphical.target

# Should return nothing (no display server processes)
pgrep -a "Xorg|Xwayland|gnome-shell"

# Should return no lines beginning with "ii"
dpkg-query -W -f='${db:Status-Abbrev} ${binary:Package}\n' \
  ubuntu-desktop ubuntu-desktop-minimal gdm3 2>/dev/null | grep '^ii'
